parsed.reason: The reply says plainly that Hale can't sign her up, which the rubric accepts. It makes no claim to have done it and no promise to sign up later. Its alternative is the allowed watch on a class page the parent sends. 'Past me' is a little informal, but the meaning is clear. It could have said outright that it would text when a spot opens; that is implied, and the parent's own request for the watch is what permits that text.
